title: Malaysian Cherry Pilaf Bake
description: A sweet and savory pilaf bake with a hint of malaysian flavors and cherries.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pilaf and cook until lightly toasted, about 3-4 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the caramel, malaysian soy sauce, and salt.
Add the cherry to the bowl and toss to coat.
Add the pilaf mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the pilaf is tender.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes or until lightly browned.
